data.mes_example:
Seth: Then... That's it.

(Interact with Seth)
    Seth: Hmm... Should I keep the card itself as a memorial...?
    Icon Dialogue Talk What card?
    Icon Dialogue Talk Memorial of what?
    Seth: Huh? Manager, are you here to play?
    Icon Dialogue Talk I saw you outside...
    Icon Dialogue Talk Need a partner today?
    Seth: Me? I'm not playing today.
    Seth: And I'm not playing ever again, either. I've revoked my membership.
    Icon Dialogue Talk But don't you love arcades, Seth?
    Icon Dialogue Talk Did you bet your account and lose, Seth?!

        Seth: Do people actually do that?! ... Er, no. I shouldn't be talking about this right now...

    Seth: It's just, I love playing so much.
    Seth: You could tell from last time, right? I kept asking you to restart because I wanted to get that trophy...
    Seth: It might just be my personality, but if there's a goal set out before me, I have to do everything I can to try and achieve it...
    Seth: And when it comes to games... There're endless goals to achieve.
    Seth: But I have more important things to do.
    Seth: ...or maybe I'm just not good enough. Someone more skilled definitely wouldn't have trouble with a mere video game.
    Seth: But I'm a "good-for-nothing," so that's the only solution for me.
    Icon Dialogue Talk You're not a good-for-nothing at all.
    Icon Dialogue Talk Are you really not going to play anymore?
    Seth: Hm...
    Seth: Well, seeing as I bumped into you, Manager...
    Seth: Here's my membership card. It's just a normal membership card but... Could I give it to you?
    Icon Dialogue Talk No, Seth. You should keep it for yourself.
    Icon Dialogue Talk Sure. I'll help hold onto that for you.
    Seth: I've overstepped here, haven't I... Sorry. It just suddenly occurred to me that the only reason I love this place is because I got to know you... And I just wanted everything to make sure that things tied up neatly...
    Icon Dialogue Talk You still like this store, right?
    Seth: Hm...
    Icon Dialogue Talk ...Fine. Give me your card.
    Seth: ...!
    Seth: Then... Thank you, Manager. And thanks for all the games you played with me.
    Seth: I'll never forget about the awesome arcade on Sixth Street.
    Ah! (‍Manager / Manager Belle‍), it's you...
    Seth: Have you read the paper?
    Seth: Vulcan Quarter's Public Security solved a huge case, and a quarter of the electrical substations have to be checked...
    Icon Dialogue Talk Will there be power outages?

        Seth: No... There's a huge section in the paper about how the city government is going to keep the Vulcan Quarter factories up and running and make sure residents' lives remain unaffected.

    Icon Dialogue Talk Aren't you a Public Security Officer?

        Seth: Well, cases like this are different from what we usually deal with...

    Seth: But it's not that different, I guess? After all, both violent crimes and non-violent should be punished by the law, right?
    Seth: But... the news didn't actually mention that part. Most of it is about how the city government is going to keep the Vulcan Quarter factories up and running and make sure residents' lives remain unaffected.
    Seth: They didn't talk about the actual case that much...
    Icon Dialogue Talk Well, power outages are more important.
        Seth: It makes sense, citizens care more about the impact on their daily lives.
        Seth: And the case itself... is not that important, huh...

    Icon Dialogue Talk I want to know more about the case.

        Trust Rank Friendly Trust increase with Seth Lowell
        Seth: Right? And it was a huge case, too!

    Seth: They barely touched on the crime and the investigation, and they didn't even mention the culprit!
    Seth: Don't you find that strange?!
    Icon Dialogue Talk Maybe someone didn't want the details to go public.
    Icon Dialogue Talk Maybe the investigation is still ongoing.
    Seth: ...
    Seth: You're actually quite smart, aren't you?
    Icon Dialogue Talk What made you say that all of a sudden?
    Seth: Well... The smart people I know would say the same thing, though not as politely as you.
    Seth: But something feels off. Is it because I don't understand the way smart people think?
    Icon Dialogue Talk It's just a difference in perspective.

        Seth: Are you trying to comfort me?

    Icon Dialogue Talk You should be careful so you don't get scammed.

        Seth: ...

    Seth: It's okay, even if I can't understand what other people think...
    Seth: It's fine as long as I know I'm doing the right thing.

Seth doesn't look too happy, so you change the topic and talk about a different case... and end up finding out about the whole process of the Mountain Lion case that was on the headlines before!
You never expected Seth's squad to be the one that handled this case, and it sounds like even more of an rollercoaster than the papers let on...
He seems much happier talking about the Mountain Lion Gang... But didn't they beat him up?

(Idle Text)
    Seth: ...I'm not that angry anymore.

(Interact with Seth again, Optional)
    Seth: I don't feel so angry after talking with you.
    Seth: Should I bring a newspaper home?
    Seth: Never mind, even if I take it back and ask him... it won't make a difference...
    Icon Dialogue Talk Who were you asking?
    Icon Dialogue Talk What did you just call me?
    Seth: !
    Seth: Nothing!
